definitions.explanation: The alarm clock feature that temporarily silences the alarm and rings again after a few minutes, or the act of using this feature.

examples.japanese: スヌーズを{何度|なんど}も{押|お}してしまう。
examples.english: I keep hitting snooze over and over.

examples.japanese: スヌーズ{機能|きのう}に{頼|たよ}りすぎて、{毎朝|まいあさ}{遅刻|ちこく}しそうになる。
examples.english: I rely too much on the snooze function and nearly end up late every morning.

notes:
From English "snooze." Refers specifically to the alarm clock feature on smartphones and alarm clocks that delays the alarm by a set interval (usually 5-10 minutes). Very commonly used in everyday Japanese, especially when talking about morning routines.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- スヌーズを{押|お}す: to hit snooze
- スヌーズを{止|と}める: to stop the snooze
- スヌーズ{機能|きのう}: snooze function
- スヌーズを{設定|せってい}する: to set the snooze
- スヌーズ{間隔|かんかく}: snooze interval

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目覚|めざ}まし: alarm clock — the device or app itself
- アラーム: alarm — the general alert sound or setting
- {二度寝|にどね}: falling back asleep — going back to sleep after waking up, which snooze enables
